<!-- @slot inventory-rows -->
| C-GS-01 | Every personal data element has a lawful basis recorded in the spec's inventory (GDPR Art. 6). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-02 | Each special-category or sensitive element is flagged, with its additional condition or limit on use (GDPR Art. 9; CCPA §1798.121). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-03 | The spec states, per element, whether the organisation acts as controller or processor (GDPR Art. 28(3)). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-04 | The record of processing is updated for this feature, or its update is a task (GDPR Art. 30). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot minimisation-rows -->
| C-GS-05 | Retention is enforced in every copy: backups, caches, search indexes, analytics stores and exports (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e); SOC 2 C1.2). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-06 | Tenant offboarding deletes or returns the tenant's data by the contractual deadline, and the plan names the proof of deletion (GDPR Art. 28(3)(g); SOC 2 C1.2). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot rights-rows -->
| C-GS-07 | Access, correction, deletion, portability and objection are each implemented or marked not applicable with a reason in the spec (GDPR Art. 15–21). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-08 | A request can be fulfilled within the legal time limit, and the request and its completion are logged (GDPR Art. 12(3); CCPA §1798.130). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-09 | An opt-out of sale or sharing is honoured, or the feature neither sells nor shares personal information (CCPA §1798.120, §1798.135). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-10 | Where the organisation is a processor, the feature lets the customer fulfil a data-subject request for their own users (GDPR Art. 28(3)(e)). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot sharing-rows -->
| C-GS-11 | Every new sub-processor is in the register, approved, and notified to customers before it receives data (GDPR Art. 28(2); SOC 2 CC9.2). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-12 | Each transfer of personal data outside the allowed regions has a named transfer mechanism (GDPR Art. 44–46). | [ ] | |
| C-GS-13 | A personal-data breach in this feature would be detected and reach the incident process in time for the 72-hour notification (GDPR Art. 33; SOC 2 CC7.3, CC7.4). | [ ] | |
